cues: The secret is in the wall.
Cellulose microfibrils run around each guard cell like the hoops of a barrel.
When a guard cell takes up water it cannot get fatter, only longer, and because the two cells are joined at their ends, they bow apart.
text: The secret is in the wall. Cellulose microfibrils run around each guard cell like the hoops of a barrel. This is radial micellation. When a guard cell takes up water it cannot get fatter, only longer, and because the two cells are joined at their ends, they bow apart.
